vehicles.summary: Highest top speed. Light, so it gets shoved around in a scrap.
Loaded roof rack makes it the heaviest. Wins every bump, loses every straight.
The taxi. No weakness, no standout strength. A good first pick.
Best handling by a distance. Makes its time on twisty tracks.
Fastest off the line and out of slow corners. The lightest, so avoid contact.
Bull bar up front: fast and heavy once rolling, but slow to get going.
Punchy launch and plenty of mass. Runs wide in corners.
